title: Surjectivity of a finite type ring map descends along a directed colimit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(A_i)_{i\in I}$ a directed system of commutative rings (ring maps $A_i\to A_{i'}$ for $i\le i'$, compatible), with colimit $A=\varinjlim_iA_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $0\in I$, let $B_0$ and $C_0$ be commutative $A_0$-algebras and $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$ a homomorphism of $A_0$-algebras which is of finite type ($C_0$ is generated as a $B_0$-algebra, via $\varphi_0$, by finitely many elements). For $i\ge0$ regard $A_i$ as an $A_0$-algebra via the transition map, and $A$ via the coprojection, and put $B_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $C_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}C_0$, $\varphi_i=\mathrm{id}_{A_i}\otimes\varphi_0:B_i\to C_i$, and $B=A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $C=A\otimes_{A_0}C_0$, $\varphi=\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\varphi_0:B\to C$. If $\varphi$ is surjective, then there is an $i\ge0$ such that $\varphi_i$ is surjective (Stacks Algebra, Lemma 07RH).

source.place: Lemma Tag 07RH (lemma-colimit-surjective, line 47547; tag verified in stacks-project/tags/tags line 9867) and its proof (generators $x_1,\dots,x_m$ of $C_0$ over $B_0$, preimages $b_j\in A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$ of $1\otimes x_j$, lifted to a finite stage, where they map to $1\otimes x_j$ after increasing $i$)
